channel.title: RT-Labs AB — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by RT-Labs AB (rt-labs).

item.title: CVE-2026-115793 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Resource exhaustion from RPC sessions kept for requests to unknown interface
item.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not release the RPC session allocated for an RPC request that names an unknown interface or object UUID, and does not start a timeout for it. Repeated requests with different activity UUIDs exhaust the available sessions. Once…

item.title: CVE-2026-115794 · 2.3 LOW — Alarm data length not validated against received frame length
item.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 passes the application alarm callback a data length derived from the variable part length field of a received RTA alarm frame without checking it against the length of the received frame. A short frame can make the callback receive…

item.title: CVE-2026-115795 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Out-of-bounds read of DCP block header in DCP Set and Identify request parsing
item.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not check that a complete block header is present in the received data before reading the next block in DCP Set and Identify requests. If the last block ends at the end of the receive buffer, the block length of the following…

item.title: CVE-2026-111736 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — NULL pointer dereference on implicit read of user specific record index
item.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 dereferences a NULL AR pointer in pf_fspm_cm_read_ind() when handling an implicit read request without a valid target AR UUID for a user specific record index, if the application has registered a read callback. A remote unauthentic…

item.title: CVE-2026-112200 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Resource exhaustion from unreleased AR and RPC session on RPC requests with incorrect endianness
item.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not release the Application Relationship (AR) and the RPC session when an RPC request is rejected because its data representation has incorrect endianness. The session and its AR remain allocated, so repeated requests exhaust…

item.title: CVE-2026-111735 · 7.1 HIGH — Integer underflow leads to out-of-bounds read in pf_cpm_c_data_ind()
item.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 contains an integer underflow in pf_cpm_c_data_ind(). When handling a received cyclic data frame while the consumer is in the FRUN or RUN state, the offset of the APDU status was computed as the frame length minus 4 using 16-bit ar…
